{"metadata":{"description":"给 DeepSeek 安装一双眼睛和一支画笔:会话里直接贴截图/图片,GLM 视觉模型先精确转写图片内容(报错信息、代码、界面逐字保留),然后 DeepSeek 继续处理你的问题——同一轮完成,全程无感;需要配图时,DeepSeek 自动调用文生图后端出图并显示在会话中。","id":"gh:1333424946","install_available":true,"language":"TypeScript","name":"dsh-multimodal","slug":"MC5lan/dsh-multimodal","topics":["deepseek-harness","dsh","dsh-plugin","dsh-plugins","multimodal","multimodal-ai","vision"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"给 DeepSeek 安装一双眼睛和一支画笔:会话里直接贴截图/图片,GLM 视觉模型先精确转写图片内容(报错信息、代码、界面逐字保留),然后 DeepSeek 继续处理你的问题——同一轮完成,全程无"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"感;需要配图时,DeepSeek 自动调用文生图后端出图并显示在会话中。"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-multimodal — multimodal eyes and hands for DeepSeek Harness"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"English | 简体中文"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"Give DeepSeek a pair of eyes and a paintbrush: paste a screenshot or image into the conversation and"},{"id":"p4s2","text":" the vision provider **you configured** first transcribes it verbatim (error messages, code, UI text"},{"id":"p4s3","text":" preserved), then **DeepSeek keeps solving your problem** — all in the same turn, no extra steps. Wh"},{"id":"p4s4","text":"en an illustration is needed, DeepSeek automatically calls the image backend and the generated pictu"},{"id":"p4s5","text":"res appear right in the conversation."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"> **Blank slate by design**: this plugin ships **no built-in models, providers, or backends**. Visio"},{"id":"p5s2","text":"n endpoints, image backends, and models are all declared by *you* — plug in whatever API you already"},{"id":"p5s3","text":" have (DeepSeek, Zhipu, Aliyun, SiliconFlow, ModelScope, Xfyun, Qianfan, local Ollama, …). Nothing i"},{"id":"p5s4","text":"s preloaded, nothing is assumed."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"> **Compatibility**: built for DeepSeek Harness `0.1.0-rc.6` (Web and headless). See CHANGELOG."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"## Features"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"| Scenario | Behavior |"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"| Plain-text chat | Straight to the DeepSeek API (unchanged) |
| Image + question (e.g. error screen"},{"id":"p9s2","text":"shot) | Your configured vision provider "looks" first → transcribes to text → **DeepSeek continues f"},{"id":"p9s3","text":"rom the transcription** (fix code, explain, propose); hitting "stop" aborts the vision call immediat"},{"id":"p9s4","text":"ely |
| Attaching an image | **No more "current model does not support images"** |
| User asks for a"},{"id":"p9s5","text":"n image | DeepSeek calls `generate_image` → the configured image backend produces pictures shown in "},{"id":"p9s6","text":"the conversation; **backend failover** tries the next backend if the active one fails (AUTH/aborted "},{"id":"p9s7","text":"skips failover — no wasted quota) |
| Any image API | A `custom` backend plugs any non-OpenAI/DashSc"},{"id":"p9s8","text":"ope API in via a small adapter file — no plugin code changes |
| Image card | Dedicated `generate_im"},{"id":"p9s9","text":"age` card: thumbnail grid, click-to-zoom lightbox, one-click download, prompt & model metadata, **cr"},{"id":"p9s10","text":"op-to-ask** (drag a region + ask), **copy params** (reproducible JSON), **retry** button on failure "},{"id":"p9s11","text":"(refine-aware) |
| Extracting text from an image | DeepSeek can call `extract_text` (OCR) → Markdown"},{"id":"p9s12","text":" / plain text / JSON; decoupled from the watch route, usable in any session |
| **Paste-key auto-con"},{"id":"p9s13","text":"nect** (0.7+) | Paste any API key into the quick-add box → platform auto-detected (key fingerprint →"},{"id":"p9s14","text":" `/models` probing) → endpoint + allow-list + credential + model list + feature enablement in one st"},{"id":"p9s15","text":"ep |
| Vision platforms | `extraProviders` accepts **any OpenAI-compatible vision endpoint** + one-c"},{"id":"p9s16","text":"lick preset cards (Zhipu, Bailian, Xfyun, ModelScope, SiliconFlow, Qianfan, local Ollama) |
| Transc"},{"id":"p9s17","text":"ription cache | Same image + same context reuses the previous transcription — no wasted vision quota"},{"id":"p9s18","text":" (LRU, per-session) |
| Vision fallback chain | Primary vision provider rate-limited/failing → autom"},{"id":"p9s19","text":"atic switch to `fallbackProviders` |
| Parallel transcription | `parallelImages` transcribes each im"},{"id":"p9s20","text":"age in its own concurrent call (fast multi-image turns) |
[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"## Security"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"Since `0.2.1`, the plugin hardens itself against malicious or hand-edited configurations:"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"- **API key allow-list** (`allowedApiKeyEnvs`): only listed env/credential names may be read as an A"},{"id":"p12s2","text":"PI key — a malicious config can no longer name `GITHUB_TOKEN` (or any other secret) as `apiKeyEnv` t"},{"id":"p12s3","text":"o exfiltrate it
- **Trusted base URLs** (`trustedBaseUrls`): custom vision providers must target off"},{"id":"p12s4","text":"icial hosts or hosts you explicitly allow — credentials cannot be silently redirected to an attacker"},{"id":"p12s5","text":" endpoint; explicitly listed **local endpoints** (e.g. `http://localhost:11434`) are allowed over pl"},{"id":"p12s6","text":"ain http and need no key
- **SSRF guard**: generated-image downloads and `reference_image` URLs refu"},{"id":"p12s7","text":"se loopback / private (RFC1918) / link-local addresses
- **No sessionId forwarding**: internal harne"},{"id":"p12s8","text":"ss session ids are never sent to third-party vision APIs
- **Prompt-injection markers**: vision & OC"},{"id":"p12s9","text":"R outputs are wrapped in explicit "untrusted context" markers before being handed to the text model
"},{"id":"p12s10","text":"- **Sensitive-data redaction** (`redactSensitive`): phone numbers / 18-digit IDs / emails are masked"},{"id":"p12s11","text":" in transcriptions (including cache hits)
- **Audit log** (`auditLog`): one line per transcription w"},{"id":"p12s12","text":"ith time / image count / bytes / latency / provider
- **Bounded memory**: transcription cache, per-s"},{"id":"p12s13","text":"ession image recall, and image-kind stats are all LRU-capped — no unbounded growth"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"## Installation"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"Prerequisites: official DeepSeek Harness (`0.1.0-rc.6+`) installed and running, Node.js 18+."},{"id":"p15s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"The repo ships prebuilt artifacts (`lib/`), so you can install right after cloning; to rebuild from "},{"id":"p16s2","text":"source, see Development."},{"id":"p17s1","text":"After restarting `dsh web`, a **「多模态 / Multimodal」** page appears in the Settings sidebar — everythi"},{"id":"p17s2","text":"ng is configured in one place:"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"- **Status bar** (one row): 识图 ✓/✗ · 画图 ✓/✗ — computed from *real* capability (transcription provide"},{"id":"p18s2","text":"r set AND registered / backend exists AND active), so it never shows "configured" when the feature i"},{"id":"p18s3","text":"s actually off
[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"## Usage"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"1. **Fastest path (recommended, 0.7+)**: Settings → Multimodal → 快速接入 → paste your API key — platfor"},{"id":"p20s2","text":"m auto-detected and connected in one step (endpoint + allow-list + credential + model list; 识图/画图 en"},{"id":"p20s3","text":"abled automatically). If the key can't be recognized, the hint says why; then pick a platform card o"},{"id":"p20s4","text":"r use a custom endpoint.
[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"## How it works"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"- The `deepseek-vision` route is the DeepSeek API with a directory that advertises image support so "},{"id":"p23s2","text":"the UI allows attachments — images are actually transcribed by the provider you configured, never se"},{"id":"p23s3","text":"nt to DeepSeek
- Image bytes are read through the dsh attachment service; the transcription instruct"},{"id":"p23s4","text":"ion defaults to "transcribe verbatim + extract key error info" and can be customized in the `dsh-mul"},{"id":"p23s5","text":"timodal:` section of `~/.dsh/settings.yaml`
- On transcription failure it degrades to a `【图片转写失败: 原因"},{"id":"p23s6","text":"】` placeholder — DeepSeek keeps going instead of hanging
- Settings UI: Settings → Multimodal (`sett"},{"id":"p23s7","text":"ings.section` slot, native look & feel like the Models page)"}],"truncated":true}
